explanation: Tradition credits it to Laozi, a name that means 'Old Master'. Its opening line warns that the Tao that can be put into words is not the eternal Tao.

claims.text: The Tao Te Ching is the founding text of Taoism (Daoism).
The Tao Te Ching is not the founding text of Confucianism, Zen Buddhism or Shinto.
Tradition attributes the Tao Te Ching to Laozi, whose name means 'Old Master'.
The Tao Te Ching opens by saying that the Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao.
The Tao Te Ching is about the Tao, 'the Way'.
